name: Verdant Mesa
geological_features: Vast elevated plateaus spanning thousands of kilometers
Deep river canyons cutting through layered sedimentary rock
Fertile alluvial plains at the base of mesas
specific_features: Ancient stone monoliths arranged in geometric patterns atop the highest mesa
A network of caves containing bioluminescent fungi
description: Verdant Mesa is dominated by enormous flat-topped highlands that rise sharply from lush lowland forests. Rivers cascade off the mesa edges in spectacular waterfalls, feeding dense canopies of broadleaf vegetation below. The planet's temperate climate supports an extraordinary diversity of animal life across its varied elevations.

Standing atop the highest plateau, the air carries the scent of wet stone and flowering vines. The silence is broken only by the distant roar of waterfalls and the calls of winged creatures that nest along the cliff faces. At dusk, mist rises from the lowlands, wreathing the mesas in pale gold.

Survey teams discovered the stone monoliths during initial mapping runs, their arrangement too precise to be natural. No civilization has been found on Verdant Mesa, yet the monoliths predate the oldest geological strata by an impossible margin. Theories range from ancient seeding expeditions to temporal anomalies embedded in the rock itself.

Verdant Mesa's combination of abundant resources, breathable atmosphere, and temperate climate makes it a prime colonization candidate. However, the monolith question remains unresolved, and several xenoarchaeological teams have reported equipment malfunctions near the structures. Whatever shaped this world may not appreciate uninvited guests.
